title: Lumen 3.2.0 Release Notes
text: New: Idempotency-Key header support for all POST endpoints. Deprecated: offset pagination in v1 list endpoints; migrate to cursor pagination with next_page_token. Fixed: webhook retries now use exponential backoff.

title: Lumen 3.3.0 Release Notes
text: Continuous batching is enabled by default for all hosted models. RetryPolicy now applies full jitter by default. Rate limit responses include a Retry-After header.

title: Lumen 3.4.0 Release Notes
text: Webhook signatures v2: X-Lumen-Signature is an HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body and a timestamp to prevent replay. New integrations must use TLS 1.3; TLS 1.2 remains available for existing clients until 2026.

title: Lumen 3.5.0 Release Notes
text: Streaming responses send heartbeat comments every 15 seconds. Batch inference jobs accept a priority field. ERR-5040 is returned when a batch job runs longer than 24 hours.
